issues.description: Error message types raise APIConnectionError inside recv_task's broad except, swallowing fatal errors
issues.detail: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError on auth_error/quota_exceeded, but recv_task wraps the call in except Exception that logs and continues. The connection error is logged and the loop spins forever on a dead session. Re-raise specifically, or set a failure flag and break to let _run handle shutdown.

issues.description: audio_format derived by f-string from unvalidated sample_rate, lying to the STTAudioFormat Literal
issues.detail: sample_rate is an unconstrained int cast to STTAudioFormat via f"pcm_{sample_rate}". A caller passing 11025 produces pcm_11025, which is not in the Literal; the server rejection is the only check. Validate against the allowed set at __init__ and raise, or accept audio_format directly.

issues.description: Reconnect loop is broken: nothing sets _reconnect_event on task failure
issues.detail: The outer while True only loops when _reconnect_event is set, but nothing sets it. If send/recv tasks raise, tasks_group re-raises and the function exits. Reconnect is dead scaffolding with no backoff, no termination function, and a transient blip kills the stream. Either wire reconnect on failure or delete the scaffolding.

issues.description: No tests shipped; streaming state-machine correctness rests on a single manual run
issues.detail: Author justifies skipping tests with 'Deepgram did it too,' but a stateful streaming protocol with partial/committed/empty-commit transitions and a speaking flag is exactly what regresses silently. At minimum add a unit test that feeds canned WS messages through _process_stream_event and asserts the event sequence. Cheap, catches real bugs.

issues.description: audio_format duplicates sample_rate on STTOptions; two fields, one fact
issues.detail: audio_format is computed once as f"pcm_{sample_rate}" then stored alongside sample_rate. If a caller mutates one, the other lies. Drop audio_format from STTOptions and format it at the single use site in _connect_ws so there is one source of truth.

issues.description: Documented parameter validation ranges are not enforced in code
issues.detail: Docstring says vad_silence_threshold_secs must be 0.3-3.0, vad_threshold 0.1-0.9, durations 50-2000, but none are checked. Users find out via an opaque WebSocket disconnect. Validate at __init__ and raise ValueError with the actual bounds; cheap and saves the next maintainer a support ticket.

synthesis.summary: Consensus: NEEDS-WORK before merge. Two P0 bugs are flagged unanimously: the audio_format f-string conversion lies to the STTAudioFormat type and accepts any sample_rate, and APIConnectionError raised from _process_stream_event is swallowed by recv_task's broad except, leaving the loop spinning on a dead session. The reconnect scaffolding is dead code because nothing sets _reconnect_event on task failure, and the absence of tests for a stateful streaming protocol is not justified by precedent. Smaller cleanups: audio_format duplicates sample_rate, and documented parameter ranges go unenforced.
